description: The file `MindmapClient.tsx` is a React component that implements an interactive mind map UI for a career navigation app. It manages state such as view parameters, selected nodes, and role details, and interfaces with various API endpoints to fetch graph data and role information. It also handles persistence of view state locally and to a backend service.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to clamp a number within a specified range.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns default filter settings for the mind map.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Returns default view state for the mind map.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Sanitizes and merges incoming state with defaults to ensure valid view state.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a stable user identification key, using personaId if available or falling back to localStorage.
